messages:
Eve: Notes from bank pilot: they need auditable export proofs + per-tenant retention overrides. Two asks: signed export manifests (verifiable) and an emergency legal-hold API.

Marco: Quick product question: bundle both into Enterprise or make proofs an add-on? Pricing will change either way.

Yara: Compliance: SOC2/ISO require immutable audit trail for holds, RBAC controls, and tests proving holds survive restores. Also signed manifests must include signature metadata and verification steps.

Devon: Eng reality: minimal path = hold flag + audit_id + export manifest signer (Redwood key). BYOK-signing needs escrow + rotation work (big). Rough: hold spike 2wks, Redwood-sign spike 2wks, BYOK signing 8-12wks incl. security review.

security-bot: Reminder: BYOK signing triggers additional legal/KM controls. Escrow policy draft required.

Eve: Proposal: Option A) Enterprise includes legal-hold + basic export manifest (Redwood-sign). Option B) Evidence Integrity add-on provides signed manifests and verification tooling. BYOK-signing is a paid premium service.

Marco: Finance input: Option A simplifies sales but reduces upsell. Option B creates clear path to monetize proof feature.

Yara: For SOC2 mapping we need acceptance checklist: API to set/unset holds (created_by, created_at, reason, audit_id), export includes hold metadata and signature_blob_url, tests: create hold -> run lifecycle -> confirm objects retained, verify signature reproducibility. Add to spike.

Devon: I'll open spike tickets for hold + Redwood-sign export and include perf targets for large exports. If spike OK, we can schedule Phase 1 next sprint.

compliance-bot: Ticket T-7654 created: "spike: holds + export signing (Redwood-sign)" assigned to Devon. Due 2026-03-30.

Eve: Sales will ask pilot for LOI + refundable deposit to prioritize BYOK signing. Meanwhile present Option B to pilot and confirm willingness to pay for Evidence Integrity.

Marco: Sync tomorrow 11am PT to finalize recommendation.

Eve: Thanks — will draft the customer-facing packaging doc after spike scope is confirmed. :thumbsup:
